description: This used to extend a preset in a private infrastructure repository. A public repository cannot resolve that, and Renovate fails the whole config rather than part of it, so the policy is stated HERE.

minimumReleaseAge mirrors the 1440-minute cooldown pnpm-workspace.yaml enforces at install time: an update Renovate opens before the cooldown expires would fail `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` in CI anyway.
